dimensions.assessment: Affects women-owned small businesses, federal agencies tracking contracting goals, and the Small Business Administration.
dimensions.evidence: small business concerns owned and controlled by women

dimensions.assessment: Changes qualification rules for federal contracting goals and requires affected businesses to seek formal certification.
dimensions.evidence: Only small business concerns owned and controlled by women that have been certified... shall be included

dimensions.assessment: The bill explicitly states that no additional funds are authorized to carry out its requirements.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to carry out the requirements of this Act

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Small Business Act, mandates new federal regulations, and establishes interim certification rules and mandatory quarterly briefings.
dimensions.evidence: Section 15(g) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 644(g)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to federal contracting goal calculations, paired with temporary interim rules and quarterly briefings leading up to implementation.
dimensions.evidence: take effect on the first day after the end of the second fiscal year beginning after the Administrator issues the regulations

missing_information: Exact administrative costs incurred by the Small Business Administration.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill alters how federal agency contracting goals are calculated by excluding self-certified women-owned small businesses without formal certification, impacting federal procurement metrics and requiring SBA rulemaking and quarterly briefings, while explicitly authorizing no additional funds.
